name: Sarah Jenkins
comment: Absolutely brilliant tool. I needed to sign an NDA quickly without creating an account or paying for DocuSign. This worked perfectly in my browser and the signature looks incredibly realistic.

name: David Chen
comment: The fact that this doesn't upload my sensitive legal documents to a random server is why I use it. 100% local processing is a game changer for privacy. Highly recommend.

name: Emily Rodriguez
comment: Very easy to use on my iPhone. Just drew my signature with my finger and saved the PDF. Deducted one star because I wish there were a few more cursive font options for typing signatures, but otherwise flawless.

name: Michael T.
comment: Lightning fast. I use it every day for signing freelance contracts and invoices. Beats opening Adobe Acrobat every time.
